description: Qmmp (Qt-based Multimedia Player) is an audio-player whose user interface is similar to winamp or xmms.
pre_install: if (Test-Path "$dir\.qmmp") { $bak = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'qmmp_portable_backup'; Remove-Item $bak -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Rename-Item "$dir\.qmmp" $bak -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path "$dir\qmmp_portable.txt") { $bak2 = Join-Path $env:TEMP 'qmmp_portable_txt_backup'; Remove-Item $bak2 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Move-Item "$dir\qmmp_portable.txt" $bak2 -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; $installer = Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Filter 'qmmp-*-win32.exe' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($installer) { & 7z x $installer.FullName -o"$dir" -y }; $exdir = Get-ChildItem $dir -Directory | Where-Object Name -like 'qmmp*' | Select-Object -First 1; if ($exdir) { Get-ChildItem $exdir.FullName -Force | Move-Item -Destination $dir -Force; Remove-Item $exdir.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; if (Test-Path $bak) { Move-Item $bak "$dir\.qmmp" -Force }; if (Test-Path $bak2) { Move-Item $bak2 "$dir\qmmp_portable.txt" -Force }
notes: 使用 https 下载 Windows (win32) 自解压安装器并将其解压为 portable 目录；保留 .qmmp 配置。请确认包内第三方二进制的许可以确保分发合规。
